meta.name: tech-debt-audit
meta.description: Thorough, file-cited technical debt audit across 9 dimensions using AST-grep (tree-sitter), grep, language-native tooling, and optionally CodeGraph knowledge graph. Produces TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes. Use when asked for codebase health check, tech debt audit, architecture review, code quality assessment, or cleanup planning. Triggers: 'tech debt', 'technical debt', 'debt audit', 'code health', 'technical debt audit', 'codebase health check', 'find tech debt', 'debt analysis', 'audit code quality'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动审计代码库技术债，生成带修复优先级的报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在清理代码库、规划重构或提升代码质量
copy.tagline_en: Automatically audit technical debt and generate prioritized fix reports
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are cleaning up codebase, planning refactoring, or improving code quality

howto.what: 按 9 个维度扫描代码库(架构、一致性、类型、测试、依赖、性能、错误处理、安全、文档),每条发现都标注 file:line:col,并写出 TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md,含严重度、工时估计和优先修复项。
howto.when: 当用户要求做技术债审计、代码健康检查或架构审查等场景时触发。

say.text: 审计这个代码库的技术债,生成报告。
检查代码健康度,列出最高优先级的问题。
say.note: 结果按严重度和投入产出比排序。

say.text: 评估项目架构和代码质量,标注具体文件位置。
say.note: 每条发现都会带 file:line:col 引用。

howto.what_en: Scans a codebase across 9 dimensions (architecture, consistency, types, tests, dependencies, performance, error handling, security, documentation), cites file:line:col for every finding, and writes TECH_DEBT_AUDIT.md with severity, effort estimates, and prioritized fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for a tech debt audit, code health check, architecture review, or similar code quality assessment.

say_en.text: Audit this codebase for tech debt and generate a report.
Check code health and list the highest-priority issues.
say_en.note: Results are ranked by severity and impact/effort.

say_en.text: Assess project architecture and code quality with file locations.
